mapper.select: SELECT id, uid, user_id, agent_id, namespace, created_at, updated_at FROM profile_memory_grants WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY agent_id, namespace
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM profile_memory_grants WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND agent_id = #{agentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO profile_memory_grants (uid, user_id, agent_id, namespace) VALUES (#{uid}, #{userId}, #{agentId}, #{namespace})
